independence_scope: within-cell only: calibration and holdout are different test sequences of the SAME cell(s) ['A123_01']. The holdout can test a calibration on a sequence it did not see; it cannot support any statement about another cell

policy.rationale: The dataset holds ONE physical cell, so no cell-level holdout exists and none is claimed. The unit is the test sequence (one raw file each). SOC100 is calibration because it is the only sequence with a discharge interruption at mid state of charge followed by a rest, a choice made from the current profile alone; SOC50 is held out and is read by no fit in this pass. The holdout supports within-cell statements only.
